test_cases.description: Verify all forward migrations (001 through 008) apply cleanly to an empty database creating all 50 authoritative domain tables.
Verify executing run_all_migrations a second time on an updated database is a safe no-op returning an empty list.
Verify migrations apply sequentially and deterministically step-by-step from 001 to 008.
Verify complete rollback in reverse order (008 down to 001) and subsequent clean reapplication without schema artifacts.
Verify verify_migration_checksums reports 0 mismatches on pristine, untampered migrations on disk.
Verify tampering with a recorded migration checksum triggers detection and raises MigrationChecksumMismatchError.
Verify foreign key integrity is strictly enforced with PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; orphan child rows are rejected with IntegrityError.
Verify primary key and unique column collisions are strictly rejected with IntegrityError.
Verify data inserted into early schema tables (001) is preserved intact through subsequent migrations (002-008).
Verify concurrent multithreaded readers and writers operate without deadlocks, corruption, or thread locking errors.
Verify every table declared across forward migrations has exactly 1 creation source (0 duplicates across 50 tables).
Verify PostgreSQL driver is installed and honest environment reporting is maintained (unverified live daemon handled gracefully).
